accessibility: The source record is classified advanced; any adaptation still requires direct checks for semantics, focus, contrast, reflow, keyboard or touch behavior, and reduced motion.
brand_posture: A merchant-centered operational system that prioritizes familiar Shopify Admin patterns, semantic color roles, clear task hierarchy, and confidence in high-frequency commerce workflows.
color: Translate semantic roles first: canvas, surface, text, subdued text, border, primary action, critical, warning, success, and selected state. A merchant app can use its own identity selectively without reassigning these jobs.
components: Resource lists, forms, banners, navigation, filters, and actions should preserve familiar behavior. Destructive and financial actions require explicit feedback and recovery where possible.
container: Use containers that keep merchant task orientation legible across the supported platforms.
failure_modes: Copying Shopify visual styling into an unrelated product and creating false platform expectations.
Using commerce status colors as decoration.
Replacing familiar admin patterns with novelty for its own sake.
Hiding critical state in pale text or color-only badges.
flows: Destination test: Commerce administration. Evaluate the relationship across transactions and checkout, and creation and management.
forms: Use explicit labels, visible validation, and recovery that preserves entered work when forms are part of the adapted product.
grid: For Shopify Polaris, the grid must preserve the layout and density relationship described in the analysis rather than imitate source dimensions.
imagery: The recorded media strategy is product evidence; no source imagery or visual assets are stored in the corpus.
interaction: Resource lists, forms, banners, navigation, filters, and actions should preserve familiar behavior. Destructive and financial actions require explicit feedback and recovery where possible.
lane_fit: Lane assignment: Commerce administration. This case earns one commerce, media, and content-heavy quota credit through merchant task orientation and semantic state color.
layout: Use moderate information density with clear grouping around resources, settings, and actions. Preserve room for status, secondary metadata, filters, and contextual actions without turning each group into a decorative card.
motion: Motion was not treated as a measured source token in the seed record; use it only for feedback, continuity, or hierarchy and mark further detail unknown.
navigation: Navigation should preserve location and the layout priority described for Shopify Polaris across the listed platforms.
responsive_behavior: Reorder by task and content priority while preserving merchant task orientation and semantic state color.
spacing: Spacing should preserve the case's medium density and make the documented hierarchy visible without adding decorative gaps.
states: Interactive states must keep the component roles in this case visible, including focus, selection, loading, error, and completion where applicable.
suitable_uses: embedded apps inside an established host product
surfaces: Translate semantic roles first: canvas, surface, text, subdued text, border, primary action, critical, warning, success, and selected state. A merchant app can use its own identity selectively without reassigning these jobs.
typography: Typography should orient and report status more than express brand personality. Use strong page and section hierarchy, literal labels, and compact supporting text. Avoid marketing-style display typography inside operational screens.
unknowns: The former public Polaris color-role and accessibility URLs now redirect to a general API page, so those historical claims are not treated as directly observed in this release.
Internal merchant-product evidence and unpublished Shopify design decisions were not inspected.
unsuitable_uses: brand marketing pages that need independent art direction
products where copying Shopify Admin conventions would create false platform expectations
visual_thesis: The system is most valuable as an operational continuity model. Merchant-facing software should feel predictable inside Shopify Admin because actions, resource hierarchy, state language, and semantic color agree with conventions merchants already know.
